description_500c: PinyPiny is a visual notes, photo journal, and freeform digital scrapbook app for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 18+). Arrange words, ordinary photos, and on-device Sticker Studio photo cutouts freely on warm paper-like pages, then revisit completed notes in a tactile card stack. Core editing runs locally on your device without creating a separate account, and finished pages export cleanly as images to Apple Photos. PinyPiny is free to download, with optional Pro (subscription or one-time Lifetime purchase) adding extra papers and fonts, inline photos, special photo frames, animation, and private Apple iCloud sync.
